## Load Data

We're going to load the Maryland Medicare prescriber data: one row for each health care provider in each year from 2022 through 2024, with the number of prescriptions (claims) they wrote for Medicare patients and what those drugs cost.

**Task** Run the codeblock below to load the data, which is contained in an RDS file.

```{r}
md_prescribers <- read_rds("data/md_partd_prescribers.rds")
```
